original_dimensions.active_picture_evidence: ffmpeg cropdetect=24:2:0 over 00:02:16-00:02:23 reports crop=632:480:112:0 on every sampled frame
original_dimensions.note: A 4:3 camcorder picture is pillarboxed inside a 854x480 container. Effective picture is 632x480 (about 1.32:1), so a 1080p timeline needs roughly a 2.25x upscale of the active area, or an authored archival frame treatment. Do not stretch to 16:9.

selected_segment.note: See qa.md. The scouted out point 00:02:24.0 does not hold against the real file: by 00:02:23 the shot has become a two-man interaction and at 00:02:24 a handshake over a Microsoft Office display. The browsing action ends around 00:02:22.5.

transformations: None applied to the original file. It is stored byte-identical to the Internet Archive `original` MPEG4 (sha1 and md5 match the published metadata).
Three PNG verification frames were extracted to evidence/frames/ with ffmpeg; one was additionally scaled to 720p height for inspection. No watermark removal, no re-encode of the original.
version_model_evidence: Not applicable: this is a real archival camcorder recording, not a generated or reenacted asset.
